questions.solution:

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.category: Mathematical Reasoning & Linear Programming :: Quantitative Deduction
questions.question:
Evaluate the integer value of the limit in [Mathematical Reasoning & Linear Programming]:
$$\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{x - \sin x}{x^3} \times 6$$
questions.solution: Using Taylor series $\sin x = x - \frac{x^3}{6} + O(x^5)$, we have $\frac{x - \sin x}{x^3} = \frac{1}{6} + O(x^2) \to \frac{1}{6}$. Multiplied by $6$, the value is $1$.
questions.explanation: Derive using rigorous mathematical theorems in Mathematical Reasoning & Linear Programming.
